outcome: length of the active phase of labor
length of the second stage of labor
maternal satisfaction with the childbirth process (McKee Childbirth Satisfaction Rating Scale)
cohort: 30 pregnant females divided into two groups of 15 each.
finding: Pilates exercise during pregnancy was found to be a safe method to reduce the length of the active phase and second stage of labor, reduce labor pain, and increase maternal satisfaction with the childbirth process.
mod_finding: Pilates exercise did not significantly reduce the need for episiotomy and caesarean section.
